title: InsightTrack: a self-hosted web analytics platform with a dual-database architecture
description:
InsightTrack is a self-hosted web analytics platform that separates its write path from its read path across two databases. PostgreSQL is the system of record for tracking events, authentication and site management; an embedded DuckDB instance, kept current by an incremental sync process, serves every analytics query. The split lets the transactional store stay normalised and write-optimised while analytical aggregations run against a columnar engine in the same process, with no separate warehouse to operate.

The platform includes an allowlist-validated SQL editor scoped to a single tenant, configurable retention that deletes from both stores, and honours Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control signals. It ships with a reproducible engine benchmark harness (seeded datasets, n=30 measured runs per query) comparing PostgreSQL and DuckDB execution times at 100K, 1M and 5M rows.
